description: Place an order and get its payment link. The order is held but not taken until the person pays at that link (card, in US dollars, on AllPay's secure page); give them the link and the total. Never pay on their behalf unless they asked you to and gave you the means. Confirm the recipient, address, phone, date and card message with the person first.

address.description: Street, number, apartment, floor, entrance code.

buyer_email.description: Where the receipt and any questions go.

card_message.description: Printed on the card with the flowers.

recipient_phone.description: Israeli or international number, digits only.

surprise.description: True: do not contact the recipient before delivery.

name: create_order
title: Place an order
